abilities.name: anger-point
abilities.effect: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.

abilities.name: defiant
abilities.effect: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.

kanto.flavorText: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

original-johto.flavorText: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

hoenn.flavorText: When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign of anger. However, since this happens instantly, there is no time to flee.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

updated-johto.flavorText: It’s unsafe to approach if it gets violently enraged for no reason and can’t distinguish friends from foes.

original-unova.flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

updated-unova.flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

kalos.flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: When Mankey starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign that it is becoming angry. However, because it goes into a towering rage almost instantly, it is impossible for anyone to flee its wrath.

original-alola.flavorText: Its raging tires it out and causes it to fall asleep, but the anger resonating in its dreams causes it to wake up—which infuriates it all over again.

updated-alola.flavorText: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.
